title: The Legend of Zelda: Phantom Hourglass

roms.name: USA with the D-pad control patch (as tested)

verified.textures: 33 of 41 textures dumped during play reproduced, all pixel-identical (incl. the title logo, a raw .ntft texture)
verified.sprites: 67 of 78 sprites dumped during play reproduced, all pixel-identical
verified.backgrounds: 1683 of 1683 BG tiles dumped during play reproduced
verified.on_device: 2026-09-23, AYN Thor: BG tiles (92160/92160 lookups), sprites and 3D textures render in HD, title logo HD

notes: All assets are standard Nitro files in NARC archives, so no game-specific reader is needed and 1773 of the 1934 texture keys come from model materials.
Only the D-pad patched ROM has been tested. The retail ROM should give the same keys wherever the patch didn't touch the graphics; run it and compare the counts with the baseline.
Phantom Hourglass renders both screens in 3D using display capture, so captured frames can't be replaced, but the textures drawn into them can.
The title logo is a raw SDK texture (Menu/Tex2D/title.ntft + .ntfp) whose palette file is shorter than the 256 colours the key hashes, so it gets the '$' palette wildcard.
